Component 1: Target 1: To establish an Informal Sector Unit (ISU) that’s functional Target 2: To establish a Social Insurance Scheme for the informal sector Target 3: Target 3: Development of partnerships with Informal Sector Associations
Component 2: Target 1: Supporting Botswana Government in the development of an approach for digital transformation of Botswana Public Sector through Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR Target 2: Supporting Botswana Government in digital transformation of their Public Sector through BPR.

Component 1 Target 1 results The ISU has been formed within the Ministry with LEA designated the Informal Sector Agency. UNDP has supported the ISU with the engagement of a Technical Advisor. The ISU through LEA distributed the short-term relief grant of P1000 to 48 000 informal sector participants. The Technical Advisor is coordinating the implementation activities through bi-weekly progress update meetings, has identified and brought onboard stakeholders like ILO, Statistics Botswana, GIZ, JICA etc who have the technical expertise to assist with implementation activities. Target 2 results: UNDP has engaged a consultant to undertake a feasibility study for a social insurance scheme for the informal sector. A technical reference group was establish to interrogate the Inception Report submitted by the consultant. The data collection is ongoing and we are expecting the final report in February 2022. Target 3 results: The Technical Advisor identified Informal Sector association like Botswana Informal Sector Association (BOISA , Thusang Basadi, WIBA and the Unions and implementation activities are carried out in partnership with the associations. Through the partnership developed, the associations have been included in the pilot project Digital Package for Women Entrepreneurs which is a EU-SmartBots partnership. 50 informal sector participants have been identified to be part of the project. The associations are also included in a study by Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
Component 2: results In the context of UNDP commitment to support the implementation of Botswana National Digital Transformation Strategy, an international Digital Re-Engineering Expert has been recruited to support driving the digital strategy. In support of achievement of one of the key goals of the strategy, i.e. public sector digital transformation and putting their services online, the expert: (1) facilitated launching the public sector business process re-engineering and digitalisation initiative (including conceptualisation of the BPR approach and detailing of its analysis and design phases, development of the BPR Roadmap and launching and supporting the initiative in 8 ministries) (2) built capacity of the Management Analysts, located across public sector institutions, and staff to drive and engage in the initiative, and (3) advised on other aspects of implementation of Digital Government, including on the need for prioritisation of implementation of relevant infrastructure and enabling technologies, modernisation of public registers and databases and their interoperability, as well as on the standardisation of business processes, and supporting organisational and technological solutions, which serve, together with building digital and leadership skills and capacities, as a precondition for successful implementation of online services, digital processes and strategy in general

Support to the informal economy recovery (output 1): 1. Conduct financial literacy and business management trainings for informal economy actors in 5 districts. 2. Conduct informal economy dialogues in 5 districts. 3. Video on financial inclusion as a pathway to formalization. 4. Develop transformation strategy for the department cooperatives. 5. Support city of Francistown on development of their informal sector strategy. 6. Support informal sector associations participation at the UNDP-ILO-AU informal economy dialogue.
